name: UQ Faculty of Science Placement Enabling Grant
provider: University of Queensland, Faculty of Science
summary: Grant for UQ science students in financial need to cover the extra costs of a required placement.
who: Can show financial need (Centrelink statements, ATO statements, family income, etc.).
Can show financial impost from your placement.
Domestic or international, enrolled in at least a 50% load in an approved program.
Doing placements of at least 120 hours in total in the year of the award.
how: Submit the online application form by 11.59pm AEST on a closing date.
catches: Allocated four times a year. Closing dates are 31 January, 30 April, 31 July and 31 October.
Next closing date is 31 October 2026, for Semester 2 or Summer placements.
